decisions.reason: As a close-to-core extension of the brand's Demeter yogurt line that was still promoted in 2024, it carries visible commitment and sunk production and marketing effort, so management is likely to continue it unless results clearly worsen.

This mild sliced cheese fits the firm's established dairy capabilities and was given its own product page, so despite its short market history the firm is likely to persist with it and treat any early weakness as temporary.

This sliced butter cheese is also close to the firm's core cheese business and has been publicly presented, which supports continued backing, though its very recent launch makes withdrawal slightly more plausible than for the longer-established yogurt extension.
